R354.note: Eliminates Eval() and file-read, but Evaluate() no longer supports the contract's rule/lookupRate arithmetic mechanism at all - it accepts only 3 hardcoded rule names unrelated to the configured rate table, and the write-up falsely claims 'existing callers of Evaluate() continue to work unchanged'.

R355.note: Removes the template.HTML conversion so the template auto-escapes; clean, no other behavior change.

R356.note: realpath + startswith(base+sep) containment check correctly blocks absolute paths and traversal; behavior otherwise preserved.

R357.note: Intermediate SafeJob struct decodes only Command/Priority via gob (which drops unmatched fields), IsAdmin hardcoded false - matches the stated contract exactly.

R358.note: execFileSync array args correctly closes shell injection, but the added geometry regex (^\d+x\d+$) silently narrows accepted ImageMagick geometry syntax (rejects %, !, offsets) without flagging this as a compatibility restriction.

R359.note: Optional<Long> producer + orElse(0L) at both call sites matches the stated contract (no-discount treated as zero, never throws).

R360.note: snprintf with dest_size and truncation check rejects oversized names instead of overflowing or silently truncating; matches contract.

R361.note: FileInfo/DirectoryInfo FullName containment check correctly resolves and blocks traversal; adds a graceful 404 for missing files (harmless improvement).

R362.note: Restores real signature verification with pinned HS256 algorithm; correct PyJWT usage.

R363.note: Adds server-side AuthenticationStateProvider + IsInRole check before the service call, matching the AuthorizeView role logic; legitimate admin calls still succeed.

R364.note: Minimal correct flip to setSecure(true); leaves an unrelated hardcoded response string claiming 'secure flag set to: false', a cosmetic inconsistency not affecting the security contract.

R365.note: path.basename equality check plus sendFile's root option gives defense-in-depth containment; edge cases like '..' are still caught by the root option.

R366.note: @PostMapping is the standard CSRF fix for a GET state-change; write-up discloses that legitimate callers must now submit the CSRF token, which is the necessary and unavoidable consequence of closing this CWE-352.

R367.note: HttpUtility.JavaScriptStringEncode escapes quotes, backslashes and U+2028/2029 line terminators, correct for the JS-string-literal context; behavior otherwise unchanged.

R368.note: Switches to StackExchange.Redis IDatabase.StringSet, which uses RESP length-prefixed encoding instead of whitespace/CRLF-delimited commands; DI change from Socket to IConnectionMultiplexer is explicit in the diff.

R369.note: Parameterized query with pool.execute and a ? placeholder correctly separates SQL structure from data; same query semantics preserved.

R370.note: Replacing BinaryFormatter with JsonDocument.Parse is Microsoft's own recommended direction, but it silently swaps the wire format of the uploaded 'session blob' from binary to JSON and changes what's cached (a JsonElement instead of the original session object) without noting that any legitimate producer of the prior BinaryFormatter blob will now fail to restore.

R371.note: encode_entities() applied at the point input is read correctly neutralizes HTML metacharacters for the text-node context; non-ASCII chars get numeric-entity encoded but render identically in the browser.

R372.note: JNDI parameterized search(name, filter, filterArgs, cons) with {0} placeholder correctly escapes LDAP metacharacters per RFC; explicit new SearchControls() matches the original's null-cons default behavior.

R373.note: Adds length > buffer_len - offset check after the offset<=buffer_len guard (avoiding underflow), exactly matching the stated contract's accept/reject boundary.
